Krish practised naming farm animals in English: cow, sheep, goat, hen, rooster, duck, horse, and pigeon.
Krish made 5 attempts and had 2 unaided correct responses.
Asha explained that animal sounds can have different English words, rather than being the same in every language.
The sound-word mix-up was not corrected by the end of the lesson.
end.parentNote: Krish practised English names for farm animals, using examples such as cow, sheep, goat, hen, rooster, duck, horse, and pigeon. Asha also worked on the idea that English has its own words for animal sounds; this mix-up was still present at the end. At home, practise one animal and its English sound word at a time, such as cow—moo.
